_comment: Cards that exist only for the modal-additional-cost test (tests/unit/modes/test_modal_cost.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_bitter` is Bitter Triumph's shape -- 'discard a card or pay 3 life'. `t_bitter_both` is the card the DSL could write before this existed, with both prices on one conjunctive cost, and is the counterfactual that charges both.

cards.name: Test Bitter
cards.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card or pay 3 life.
Destroy target creature.

cards.name: Test Bitter Both
cards.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, discard a card and pay 3 life.
Destroy target creature.
